name: CineTrackSelector
meaning: byte 0 of a cinematic track header (Cine.targetDesc)

name: CINE_TRACK_CAMERA
meaning: the cinematic camera block (+0x8cc); sets hasCameraTrack

name: CINE_TRACK_OBJECT
meaning: scenaric object: index = WAR resource-table index resolved by Scenaric_FindByRecord; saved/restored and flagged 0x80

name: CINE_TRACK_OBJECT_SPEAKER
meaning: like 1, but also the only selector searched for the dialogue speaker (msg 0x58). How it otherwise differs from 1 is unknown

name: CINE_TRACK_STATIC
meaning: world static object: index into the table at *0x585060; rendered by Cine_RenderTaggedObjects

name: CINE_TRACK_STATIC_B
meaning: same resolution as 3; the difference is unknown
